one_liner.quote: You must be a verified user... To authenticate API requests, use basic authentication... or an OAuth access token.

gating_notes.value: API tokens are being retired (July 2026) and will be disabled by April 2027; authentication requires a verified user or OAuth app registration.
gating_notes.quote: Important: Zendesk is removing API tokens as an authentication method... By April 30, 2027, all API tokens will stop working.

oauth_details.value: OAuth 2.0 access‑token flow; obtain token via Zendesk OAuth app and include it in the Authorization header as a bearer token.
